data.rows: split == test (RIGID scores, bootstrap); split == calib & pool == vision_native (1%-FPR threshold only)

settings.i: clean (VISION native camera JPEG vs clean PNG fakes)

rigid.input: condition applied to the 512 crop PNG (004 load_cond) -> 224 center crop -> [0,1]
rigid.noise: n ~ N(0, sigma^2) added in [0,1] pixel space on the 224 crop, AFTER the condition, BEFORE mean/std normalization, then clip to [0,1]
rigid.noise_seed: CPU torch.Generator, seed = first 8 bytes of sha256('<image sha256>:<draw>:<sigma:.4f>') & (2**63-1)
rigid.score: 1 - cos(f(x), f(x+n)), averaged over the 4 draws; higher = fake; never flipped

feature_variants.post: last_hidden_state CLS (after the final LayerNorm = the DINOv2 embedding) -- PRIMARY, fixed before any result
feature_variants.pre: hidden_states[-1] CLS (before the final LayerNorm = 004/B0 'primary' CLS convention) -- sensitivity

b0.recipe: 005 A0: primary 1536-d clean features of b0_train rows, standardised with b0_train reals' mean/std, probe.fit_probe(seed=0, groups=sha256, class_weight='balanced'), LOGO (logo_<g> trained without g's fakes)
b0.macro: mean over generators of AUROC(test native reals vs g's TEST-split fakes) [primary]; 005-style (all fakes of g, train+test split) reported as sensitivity

aggregation.auroc: LOGO-macro over generators (each generator's fakes vs the same reals); pooled AUROC also reported
aggregation.bootstrap: metrics.bootstrap_weights: reals by device cluster, fakes by image stratified per generator; paired for differences

verdict.source: docs/04-phase4-plan.md Amendment 5 (point estimates; CIs reported alongside)
verdict.SUPPORTED: AUROC(i) - AUROC(iii-p) >= 0.10 at best sigma AND B0 gap (same cell) < 0.05
verdict.best_sigma: argmax over sigma of AUROC(i) (per arm x firefly variant cell)
verdict.gap_iv_p: reported, not used in the label

operating_point.threshold: metrics.threshold_for_fpr on calib-split native reals (setting i), per sigma

d008.subset: 16 native test reals + 16 test fakes (seed 0, sorted shas), orig arm, clean, draw 0, all sigmas

pipeline_check_vs_004: unnoised pre-LN CLS from our forward vs 004 cache primary[:, :768] on the same 32 images, scaled tol 1e-3
